consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the 1993-03-09 show at Rosemont Horizon featured a solid performance with notable energy, particularly in the second set. Highlights include strong renditions of classic songs, although some felt certain moments lacked inspiration.
standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.2 for 22 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: While many fans praised the energy and specific performances, there were also criticisms regarding the overall show quality and some song renditions, leading to a mixed sentiment.
